selection_rule: Equal weight of fixed validation AUROC and most-test-like quartile AUROC
external_pretrained_tool: NLTK English POS tagger and base prajjwal1/bert-mini pretrained weights; only supplied competition labels used for authorship training
caveat: Repeated model selection on fixed validation and test-like subset causes optimistic estimates. Test text is used without authorship labels only for auxiliary test-likeness grouping; no final feature extractor uses test labels.
source: User confirmed the final recommended CSV including BERT, reported score around 0.97, and selected this model for the team.
correction: The earlier 0.956 report was superseded by the user clarification; it must not be attributed to this selected final CSV.
